observed_candidate.scope: installer correction; not prerequisite for study

clinical_matrix: Existing central Work registry; use current version, not a duplicate
scope: Documentary study before further interface implementation; individual emergency clinician; synthetic cases only

preflight: Read AGENTS.md, STATE.md, current IMPLEMENTACION and ORQUESTACION, clinical QA gates and latest central matrix
Verify receiver, candidate and guide blob; recover prior exact evidence before new research
Apply the owner MCP policy in AGENTS.md to PR142 and each study lane: prefer authorized operational MCP only where effective; reuse exact evidence; no unnecessary calls or transfers
Share the same guide version and exact scope with all primary reviewers
coordination.dispatch_rule: Parallel independent reviews by Claude, Gemini and Codex; do not share other first-pass answers until collected. Antigravity studies consolidated version after primary reviews. Missing channel or response = record blocker, not fictional execution.

mcp_policy.scope: All lanes and project pending tasks
mcp_policy.rule: Prefer where effectively useful and authorized; preserve exact source identity, independence and privacy; use permitted alternative if needed; configuration is not execution.

coordination.receipt_rule: Prepared is not dispatched; actual transmission/acknowledgement and returned artifact required for state transitions. No auto-dispatch by age, no new task IDs in parent clinical/implementation queue.
coordination.reconcile: One coordinator records dispositions per proposal: ADOPTAR/REFORMULAR/APLAZAR/DESCARTAR with material rationale and evidence; owner decisions only on new mature clinical questions; preserve previous approvals; if independent review unavailable, report partial, do not fabricate it.
coordination.adoption_gate: Consolidated guide v1.0 and explicit owner acceptance of scope before new UI implementation; existing authorized technical repairs remain separate.

lanes.focus: Workflow and UX from arrival to end of shift; FAST/NOTE first, TREATMENT/DISCHARGE/TESTS, accessibility, interruption, cover and visual hierarchy
lanes.read: Guide sections 1–3, 5 Claude, 6; PR139/140 and ClinicalMinimal prior evidence
deliverables: Prioritized design delta and layout proposals
Measured UX criteria to test, not invented results

lanes.focus: Clinical safety, minimum required inputs by scenario, diagnosis established vs suspicion, decision branches, alerts, abstention and evidence gaps
lanes.read: Guide sections 2–3, 5 Gemini, 6; existing clinical contracts, owner decisions and source restrictions
deliverables: Only genuinely new mature owner decisions; no new dosing or clinical claims

lanes.focus: Map existing components, engines, exports, OCR/voice capability, episode guards, local/web/PWA/offline availability and negative test gaps; no implementation
lanes.read: Guide sections 2–4, 5 Codex, 6; exact current tree and QA receipts
deliverables: Synthetic acceptance and negative test coverage gaps

lanes.focus: Resolve conflicts and preserve evidence; prioritize high-value changes, one synthesis, no parallel backlog
deliverables: Disposition matrix with reasons and traceability
Explicit incomplete review boundaries and remaining owner decisions

lanes.focus: Independent review of exact synthesis: workflow, patient mix-up, data loss, clinical boundaries, units, alerts, provenance and privacy
deliverables: Scoped findings with severity, evidence and corrective proposal

lanes.focus: Publish consolidated study guide; record actual reviewer responses, owner scope decisions and accepted increments, or partial state if evidence incomplete
deliverables: Guide v1.0 if acceptance requirements satisfied; otherwise identified partial version
Traceability/disposition record, precise links and commits
No implementation, no merge or clinical authorization

metrics.rule: Measure during existing real project work; no invented comparisons, time savings or token savings. Keep accepted contracts and controls intact.
